dispatchVolcCompatibleSeedanceActionPost.title: Create visual validation session
dispatchVolcCompatibleSeedanceActionPost.description: Create a real-person visual validation session through the Volc-compatible Action API. Returns the official ResponseMetadata and Result shape with BytedToken, H5Link, and CallbackURL.

dispatchVolcCompatibleSeedanceActionPost.title: Get visual validation result
dispatchVolcCompatibleSeedanceActionPost.description: Get the mapped real-person material GroupId through the Volc-compatible Action API after the H5 validation succeeds. The operation returns the official ResponseMetadata and Result shape.

view.description: compact by default; full returns the complete OpenAI-compatible list.

recommended_for.description: Sort non-chat models for a task; include recommendation evidence.

tag.description: Filter by a public capability tag.

listModels.description: Lists the currently available models. Use `view=compact` for model selection and `view=full` for the existing OpenAI-compatible discovery shape. Native API calls default to `full`; integrations may choose `compact` as their default. Non-chat recommendations are available through `recommended_for`.

cancelAnthropicMessageBatch.description: Cancels an Anthropic Message Batch when cancellation is still available for that batch.

stream.description: Streaming is not supported for compaction.

compactResponse.description: Compacts Responses input and returns the native `response.compaction` contract. The request model must be available on a same-protocol Responses path.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

tools.description: Tool definitions available to the model.

tool_choice.description: Tool choice policy or explicit tool selection.

metadata.description: Request metadata echoed into downstream logs or traces when supported.

thinking.description: Thinking configuration for compatible Anthropic-style models.

createAnthropicMessage.description: Creates a model response using Anthropic's native request format. Supports Claude models with vision and streaming. **Authentication:** Use `x-api-key` header or `Authorization: Bearer` header.

tools.description: Gemini tools; allowed types/combinations depend on the selected service.

createChatCompletion.description: Create an OpenAI-compatible chat completion. For inline image_url data URLs, declare the byte-accurate image MIME type. The MCP boundary corrects recognized PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF payloads declared as application/octet-stream and rejects unrecognized generic binary image payloads before sending a billable request.

top_logprobs.description: Top token count per position; requires logprobs.

service_tier.description: Standard tier pricing; auto/default forwarded; flex/priority/fast/ultrafast ignored.

stream.description: If true, returns a stream of events

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum completion tokens for newer reasoning-enabled model families

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort hint for compatible model families.

service_tier.description: Standard tier pricing; auto/default forwarded; flex/priority/fast/ultrafast ignored.

tools.description: Tools; allowed types/combinations depend on the selected service.

background.description: Whether to run the response asynchronously.

previous_response_id.description: ID of a previous response to continue.

store.description: Whether the response is stored for later retrieval.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may issue parallel tool calls.

include_obfuscation.description: Whether streamed events include obfuscation fields.

stream.description: Whether to retrieve the response as an event stream.

starting_after.description: Sequence number after which streaming events are returned.

retrieveResponse.description: Retrieves a stored Responses API response by TokenLab response id. Ownership checks return 404 when the response is missing or unavailable to the current API key.

id.description: Returned id/task_id or the ID in poll_url.

getAsyncTask.description: Retrieves the status and result of an asynchronous generation task. Prefer the `poll_url` returned by the create response; `/v1/tasks/{id}` is the canonical fixed status endpoint for video, music, and 3D jobs.

id.description: Returned id/task_id or the ID in poll_url.

cancelAsyncTask.description: Cancels a queued asynchronous task when cancellation is supported for the selected task. Cancellation currently supports queued Seedance video tasks (`seedance-2.0` and `seedance-2.0-fast`) while they are still waiting to run. Tasks that are already processing, completed, failed, expired, or unsupported are not cancelled.

createSystemOneDecision.description: Evaluate typed Noul probability, Choice, and Score questions against shared state using the native System One endpoint. Discover a decision model with list_models/get_model first. Returns synchronous structured decisions, not chat text. A decision does not authorize an external action.

createTranslation.description: Translates text into a target language using the current translation request format.

timestamp_granularities.description: Timestamp granularity selection. Requires verbose_json output when requesting word-level timestamps.

prompt.description: Image prompt; required only if get_model lists prompt.

size.description: Model-specific image size; check get_model for sizes and limits.

quality.description: Model-specific image quality; check get_model for accepted values.

prompt_extend.description: z-image-turbo prompt expansion; default false; true uses expansion pricing.

async.description: Async task if the model supports it.
Async task if the model supports it.

operation.description: Video operation; if omitted, inferred from inputs. Send explicitly.

video_url.description: Public video URL for video-to-video or motion control.

reference_image_type.description: Image reference role: asset/style; alias: referenceImageType.

audio_url.description: Public audio URL for a supported audio-input operation.

ratio.description: aspect_ratio alias; if both are sent, values must match.

outputAudio.description: output_audio alias; all supplied audio toggles must match.

generate_audio.description: output_audio alias; all supplied audio toggles must match.

bgm.description: Audio control; support varies by model and operation.

audio_type.description: Audio control; support varies by model and operation.

voice_id.description: Audio control; support varies by model and operation.

watermark.description: Watermark toggle where supported; Seedance default: false.

priority.description: Task priority where supported; incompatible with service_tier=flex.

return_last_frame.description: Return last frame where supported; Seedance default: false.

output_audio.description: Audio-output selector for operations that declare it. Omission follows the model default; `false` requests silent output only when allowed. See the audio behavior above and the selected model detail.

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the video

cfg_scale.description: Prompt adherence strength (0-20) for models that expose CFG-style control.

motion_strength.description: Motion intensity (0-1) for models that expose it.

material_asset_id.description: TokenLab Seedance material asset ID returned by /v1/videos/assets or from a real-person group returned by GetVisualValidateResult. Use it after the asset is ACTIVE with Seedance models that can use the TokenLab material library. The asset must belong to the current account. This field is a generic reference input; to assign first-frame, last-frame, or reference-image semantics explicitly, put asset://<material_asset_id> in start_image, end_image, or reference_images.

video_urls.description: Compatibility array for video-conditioned flows when multiple input videos are supported by the selected model. Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 10 aggregate video inputs; other video models retain the shared limit of 3 references unless the model details specify a lower limit.

audio_urls.description: Compatibility array for audio-conditioned flows when multiple audio references are supported by the selected model. Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 10 aggregate audio inputs and permits pure-audio reference requests without a prompt; other video models retain the shared limit of 3 references unless the model details specify a lower limit.

execution_expires_after.description: Optional execution expiry window in seconds for compatible video models. Seedance defaults to 172800 seconds when omitted.

safety_identifier.description: Optional safety/user trace identifier for compatible video models. If omitted for Seedance, TokenLab uses user when provided.

createVideo.description: Creates an asynchronous video generation task. The response returns a canonical task ID and usually a preferred `poll_url`; clients should poll `poll_url` first, or use `/v1/tasks/{id}` as the fixed status endpoint.

mv.description: Suno model version; required for MUSIC/default action, omitted for lyrics-only.

prompt.description: Prompt required for music/lyrics/upload-cover/upload-extend; omit for add-instrumental.

audio_url.description: Public audio URL; omitted audio_operation defaults to upload-cover.

audio_operation.description: upload-extend needs continue_at; add-instrumental needs audio_url/title/tags/negative_tags.

continue_at.description: Continuation time in seconds; required for upload-extend.

createMusic.description: Creates a music generation task using Suno. Returns a task ID for polling.

prompt.description: 3D prompt; required only if get_model lists prompt.

create3D.description: Creates a 3D model generation task using Tripo3D. Returns a task ID for polling.

rotateWebhookSecret.description: Replace the signing secret and return the new secret once. In-flight deliveries may use the previous secret. Requires TOKENLAB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN (mt-...) for the workspace; sk-... keys are not accepted.

listWebhooks.description: List workspace webhooks. Requires TOKENLAB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN (mt-...) for the workspace; sk-... keys are not accepted.

createWebhook.description: Create a workspace webhook; save the returned signing secret. Requires TOKENLAB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN (mt-...) for the workspace; sk-... keys are not accepted.

getWebhook.description: Read a webhook without revealing its secret. Requires TOKENLAB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN (mt-...) for the workspace; sk-... keys are not accepted.

updateWebhook.description: Update URL, events, description or active state. Resuming resets failures. Requires TOKENLAB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN (mt-...) for the workspace; sk-... keys are not accepted.

deleteWebhook.description: Delete a webhook and its delivery history. Requires TOKENLAB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN (mt-...) for the workspace; sk-... keys are not accepted.

testWebhook.description: Send webhook.test; inspect outcome to confirm receipt. Requires TOKENLAB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN (mt-...) for the workspace; sk-... keys are not accepted.

listWebhookDeliveries.description: List delivery outcomes, HTTP statuses and cumulative attempts. Requires TOKENLAB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN (mt-...) for the workspace; sk-... keys are not accepted.

input.description: Input text(s) or token array(s) to embed.

createEmbedding.description: Creates an embedding vector representing the input text.

createMultimodalEmbedding.description: Creates embeddings for multimodal input items. Text input is generally available; image input may require feature enablement.

voice.description: Voice selector; some MiniMax models also accept voice_id.

instructions.description: Style instructions for supported OpenAI-compatible TTS models.

scope_id.description: Reserved scope cursor; returns an explicit unsupported error.

getPricing.description: Returns the public pricing surface for active models, with optional provider and tag filters.

rerankDocuments.description: Reranks documents by relevance to a query using semantic similarity.

group_id.description: TokenLab material group ID. Required for liveness_face materials; optional for aigc_avatar.

before_id.description: Return batches before this batch id

after_id.description: Return batches after this batch id

listAnthropicMessageBatches.description: Lists native Anthropic Message Batches for the authenticated organization.

resolution.description: Requested output resolution. Model-specific availability still applies.

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio. The official default is false.

createVolcCompatibleSeedanceTask.description: Creates a Seedance 2.0 video task with the official Volc REST body and response shape. Authentication uses a TokenLab Bearer API key. TokenLab additionally accepts an optional Idempotency-Key header so a client can recover the same task ID after a lost create response.

listVolcCompatibleSeedanceTasks.description: Lists recent Seedance compatibility tasks for the authenticated organization.

pageSize.description: Requested page size; page_size is also accepted.
Requested page size; page_size is also accepted.

listGeminiModels.description: Lists enabled models through the Gemini-compatible v1beta model discovery surface.

countAnthropicMessageTokens.description: Counts input tokens for an Anthropic-compatible messages request without creating a model response. Authentication is required; the operation is not billed. Verified upstream counting is preferred. Upstream availability failures return a local estimate marked by X-TokenLab-Count-Tokens-Source: local_estimate. Platform authentication, permission and input errors remain errors. Bound files unreadable locally require upstream counting.

createAnthropicMessageBatch.description: Creates a native Anthropic Message Batch. Requests use the same Anthropic message parameters as /v1/messages.

deleteAnthropicMessageBatch.description: Deletes an Anthropic Message Batch when deletion is supported for that batch.

deleteResponse.description: Deletes a stored Responses API response. This operation is deletion, not cancellation of an in-progress response.

geminiCountTokens.description: Counts tokens using the native Gemini CountTokens contract. Unknown fields and either official ProtoJSON field-name spelling are forwarded best-effort.

getGeminiModel.description: Retrieves model metadata through the Gemini-compatible v1beta surface.

getModel.description: Retrieves current model details, including supported operations, request parameters, request endpoints, selector limits, and pricing when available. Non-chat integrations should read these current model-specific request details before creating a request.

getVideoTask.description: Retrieves the status and result of a video generation task. New clients should prefer the `poll_url` returned by create responses, or use `/v1/tasks/{id}` as the canonical fixed status endpoint. The `/v1/videos/generations/{id}` path remains for backward compatibility.

retrieveAnthropicMessageBatch.description: Retrieves the status and metadata for a native Anthropic Message Batch.

retrieveAnthropicMessageBatchResults.description: Downloads JSONL results for a completed native Anthropic Message Batch.

updateSeedanceMaterialAsset.description: Updates a Seedance material asset owned by the authenticated organization.
